An original young woman with blonde

black lace sleeves that rise above her
head. She wears a black floral lace top
with a soft tied neckline. Her expression
is calm and direct, with soft peach lips. A
pale blue sky and blurred foliage in the
background. Soft natural light. Palette of
black, peach, and sky blue. Romantic
and dramatic, in the style of a summer
lace editorial.
